what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Guinea in Angola: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9146 Guinean asylum seekers in Angola, 16.2% of all asylum seekers from Guinea.
Refugees from Guinea, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, Belgium and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Guinea in later years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 7 asylum seekers.
The figure has been at its highest level from 2020 to 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2014 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Angola.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Angola only.
